full_judgment: 10. It is admitted fact that, the suit property along with other adjacent properties were acquired by the Government on 12-12-1994 by way of acquisition and the said property was handed over to the Mohammadpur Housing PC Culture Farming Co-operative Society, vide deed No. 944 dated 21-4-1985 and subsequently, by a registered deed of allotment No. 980 dated 3-3-1987, the suit Plot No. 44, Road No. 6, Block—Kha comprises 2.50 Katha of land were allotted to the plaintiff and the Housing Society, vide registered deed of allotment dated 3-3-1987, has been handed over to the plaintiff. The plaintiff herself deposed before the court and proved the document of title, marked as Exhibit 2, while one Md Enamul Haque, deposed as PW 1, has corroborated the case of the plaintiff by adducing all necessary documents, vide the attested photocopy of the DCR mutation case, whereby khatian has been opened in the name of the plaintiff, which are still lying in the LCR, but the same were not exhibited, since these are the photocopies and prepared by the Government attaching presumption under section 114 of the Evidence Act. Both the courts below have taken notice and the defendant could not deny the genuineness of these documents, filed by the plaintiff. In addition to that, the plaintiff has submitted City Corporation holding Tax payment receipts No. 17977 dated 28-2-2014 in original, issued by Dhaka North City Corporation, to prove her possession in the suit property. The trial court has examined all these documents and had passed the judgment and decree in favour of the plaint, which the defendant ought to have complied with instead of causing harassment to the litigant at the cost of public fund and by abusing the official position as a public servant, in a case like the instant one. Rather, the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka, representing the Government, preferred Title Appeal No. No.483 of 2016, without any genuine cause and has lost in that appeal as well. The appellate court has also passed the impugned judgment and decree dated 10-10-2017 (decree signed on 17-10-2017), after himself examining the evidence on record oral, and documentary, and having discussed all the relevant facts and issues, independently, he has dismissed the appeal. It is the admitted case of the plaintiff that, she is the owner and possessor of the suit property and a clear mistake was done by the concerned person, who was wrongly recorded her plot in the khatian No.1.
